name: UI Reviewer
description: Evaluate UI/UX quality of a website or screenshot. Use this when the user asks to review, evaluate, rate, or critique the UI/visual design of a URL or image. Automatically navigates to the URL, captures screenshots, checks accessibility, and scores visual design, layout, typography, and professionalism.

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: Action: review_url (evaluate a website by URL — navigates, screenshots, and scores automatically), review_image (evaluate a base64 screenshot), check_accessibility (a11y audit only)

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: Website URL to evaluate (required for review_url, check_accessibility). The tool navigates to the URL automatically — no need to fetch or screenshot it first

inputs.name: viewports
inputs.description: Viewport list: desktop (1280x800), mobile (375x812). Auto-detected from device context — usually no need to specify

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: Output format: json or human. Default: json
